targets.name: json_escape
targets.title: Fast JSON string escaper (JS)
targets.summary: Optimize jsonEscape(str) in plain ESM JavaScript for minimum execution cost while preserving exact RFC 8259 string escaping on all UTF-16 inputs.
targets.approach: Export jsonEscape(str) with zero comments, imports, or dynamic eval, strictly beating the holder latency across 6 interleaved seeded rounds.
